units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 12:10">Targ. II Kings XII, 10</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="H00811"><he>חוּ׳</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Arakhin 30a:11">Arakh. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (prov.) <he>לאו עכברא גנב אלא ח׳ גנב</he> not the mouse is the thief but the hole (which hides the theft, i.e. fine the purchaser of the slave but not the seller).
<cite ref="Arakhin 30a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אי לאו … ח׳ מנא ליה</he> but for the mouse (which steals), whence would the hole have something to hide?—Pl. <cite ref="H00452"><he>חוֹרָאֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 14:11">Targ. I Sam. XIV, 11</cite>.—
